annotations.title: Get the records for a request

description: Look up the evidence records Guardian holds for one request, to see what was decided and whether the call ran. It changes nothing and runs no tool, so calling it again is safe. Returns the requestId and its list of records; an unknown requestId, or Guardian unreachable, returns ok: false with a reasonCode. Use it after an unknown or unclear outcome, before trying a call again.

requestId.description: The requestId of an earlier call, from guardian_invoke_tool or guardian_claim. Starts with req_.

name: guardian_record
